title: Simplex SMP
description: Simplex SMP is the ultimate no-wipe survival server featuring keep inventory and secure land claims.
body:
# 🌍 Simplex SMP
### The Ultimate No-Wipe Semi-Vanilla Survival Experience

**Simplex SMP is** your forever survival home—a place where you can claim your land, keep your inventory when things go wrong, and build your legacy on a map that will never reset. 

Whether you are a hardcore builder, an explorer, or just looking to chill with friends after a long day, we provide the perfect, stress-free environment for your Minecraft journey.

---

### 🛡️ OUR CORE PROMISE

> **🛑 ZERO MAP WIPES, EVER.**
>
> We believe the time and effort you put into your builds should be respected. 
> * **Permanent World:** We will never delete or reset the map. Your progress is safe forever.
> * **Stress-Free Survival:** Keep Inventory is permanently enabled.
> * **Grief Protection:** Our robust claiming system ensures nobody touches your hard work.

---

### ⚡ Server Highlights

* ♾️ **No Resets:** Build massive projects without the fear of losing them to a season wipe.
* 🎒 **Keep Inventory:** Focus on building, exploring, and having fun without the frustration of losing your gear.
* 🏰 **Secure Land Claims:** An easy-to-use golden shovel claiming system. You control who can interact with your base.
* 🚀 **Premium Performance:** Optimized for zero lag and locked high TPS, ensuring a buttery-smooth experience even with complex redstone.
* 👥 **60 Player Slots:** The perfect balance—large enough for a bustling economy and active chat, but small enough to maintain a tight-knit community.
* 🤝 **Active 24/7 Community:** Fair play, friendly players, and active moderation.

---

### 🛠️ The Semi-Vanilla Philosophy

We love the core Minecraft experience, which is why **everything at its heart is pure Vanilla**. However, we’ve carefully selected a few helpful, quality-of-life plugins to enhance the gameplay. 

You get the authentic survival feeling, but without the tedious, annoying parts. No overpowered kits, no pay-to-win mechanics—just pure, enhanced survival.

---

### 🎮 True Crossplay & Console Friendly

Simplex SMP is built from the ground up to support everyone, regardless of what device they play on. We offer seamless crossplay between **Java Edition** and **Bedrock Edition**.

**Playing on Console? No Problem!**
We know joining custom servers on Xbox, PlayStation, or Nintendo Switch can be a hassle. That's why we made it incredibly easy:
> 👤 **Simply add `SimplexSMP` as a friend!**
> Once added, the server will automatically appear in your native Friends tab. No complicated DNS tricks or external apps required. Just join and play!

---

**Adventure awaits. Claim your land and start your legacy today!**
